{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am weighing whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" \"most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" means the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability or the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"best expected value."}

{"type":"thought","data":" but mellren may offer"}

{"type":"thought","data":" work before deciding."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am calculating the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payout mechanics. A"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 100-token bet at 0.655"}
{"type":"thought","data":" buys roughly 153 shares."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If ex-RUSTEC wins, "}

{"type":"thought","data":"The user's record is"}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's record "}

{"type":"thought","data":" wins. The competition"}
